jobs.description:
Join BEUMER Group Innovation & Development in creating solutions that power the next level of logistic sortation systems worldwide. As a Robotics Software Engineer at BEUMER Group, you’ll design innovative solutions that drive efficiency and reliability in sortation and handling systems for logistic sites around the globe.

Our logistics customers seek innovative solutions to improve the efficiency of their sites. This includes automating manual processes through technologies such as mobile carrier robots, articulated robots, and computer vision software. More broadly, digitalization is a key driver of efficiency improvements.

To meet these needs, we are intensifying our focus on innovation and investing more in bringing new products to the market to address our customers’ evolving needs, making this an exciting time to join BEUMER Group.

Global innovation team

As our new Robotics Software Engineer, you will join a local, cross-functional Innovation & Development team consisting of highly skilled professionals in computer vision, robotics, user experience design, software architecture, and software development. The team operates in a global setup and collaborates closely with colleagues across locations and disciplines. The team's mission is to develop innovative products and systems for the logistics industry.

In your role as Robotics Software Engineer, you will:

• Develop, maintain, and debug software on industrial PCs and robotic platforms, including communication and computer vision applications.

• Configure, program, and integrate industrial robots and motion control systems.

• Work with geometric and spatial calculations related to robot motion, object positioning, and vision-guided applications.

• Participate in the development of new products, from early prototypes to market-ready solutions.

• Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across disciplines and locations in a global organization.

Driving business value

You have a strong background in designing and implementing automation solutions across a range of software platforms. You are innovative, proactive, and capable of developing automation systems and software that enhance efficiency and create business value.

You bring the following qualifications to the role:

• A degree in computer science, engineering, physics, or a related field.

• Experience with robotics and automation technologies, preferably from a similar or related industry.

• Experience developing near real-time software and solid knowledge of C#. Experience with Python, Docker, and microservice architecture is an advantage.

• Interest in robotics software and technologies, particularly in combination with computer vision applications.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic environment.

• Strong understanding of geometry and spatial reasoning, including the ability to model and calculate physical dimensions, positions, and movements in real-world systems.

Want to know more?

See our video from PostNord Logistics: Logistic system - BEUMER Group.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding this position, please do not hesitate to contact Team Manager of Logistic System Product Development Ejnar Nielsen on +45 2721 4733 or Talent Acquisition Lead Søren Elkjær Holm on +45 3176 0448.

BEUMER Group

Conveying, loading, palletizing, packing, sortation and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all of our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

Job description

Are you an experienced HR professional who enjoys combining HR operations, employee support and employment compliance in an international environment?

We are looking for a structured, service-minded and proactive HR Generalist to join our Global People Support team. You will take a key role in supporting employees hired from Denmark and become a central point of contact for matters related to Danish employment administration, employee cases and HR processes.

You will work closely with employees, managers, HR colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure that HR processes are handled professionally, efficiently and in line with Danish employment legislation, collective agreements and internal requirements.

As part of our Global People Support team, you will contribute to delivering a high-quality and consistent HR service across the organization. At the same time, you will take particular ownership of Danish employment administration and help strengthen our knowledge, processes and ways of working within this area.

Your Responsibilities

As HR Generalist, you will manage and coordinate a broad range of HR activities across the employee lifecycle, including:

• 
Managing employee cases related to Danish employment legislation and applicable collective agreements

• 
Coordinating sickness absence administration and follow-up

• 
Handling pension-related employee administration

• 
Coordinating work injury and accident reporting

• 
Providing guidance to employees and managers on Danish employment administration and HR processes

• 
Managing correspondence with relevant authorities and supporting statutory reporting requirements

• 
Maintaining accurate employee master data and HR settings in D365 HR and related systems

• 
Preparing and issuing employment-related documentation, including employment contracts and social security documentation

• 
Supporting continuous improvement and standardization of HR administrative processes

• 
Collaborating closely with colleagues across HR to ensure a consistent and professional employee experience

Job requirements

What We Are Looking For

We imagine that you have solid experience from an HR operational environment and enjoy taking ownership while working collaboratively with others.

Ideally, you:

• 
Have experience from an HR Generalist, HR Administrator, HR Coordinator or HR Operations role

• 
Have good working knowledge of Danish employment law, collective agreements and HR administration

• 
Have experience handling employee cases and correspondence with Danish authorities

• 
Are comfortable working with HR systems and maintaining accurate employee data

• 
Work in a structured and detail-oriented way and are comfortable managing several cases and priorities simultaneously

• 
Have a service-minded approach and enjoy supporting both employees and managers

• 
Communicate confidently and professionally in Danish and English, both verbally and in writing

• 
Are collaborative, approachable and comfortable working in an international HR environment

• 
Take ownership of your responsibilities and naturally look for opportunities to improve processes and ways of working

What We Offer

At Global Wind Service, you will join an international organisation operating in the renewable energy sector and become part of a global HR community where collaboration, responsibility and continuous improvement are an important part of how we work.

We offer:

• 
An opportunity to join an international company within the wind industry

• 
A role with real ownership and the opportunity to develop your expertise within Danish HR operations

• 
Close collaboration with colleagues across our global HR organisation

• 
Opportunities for professional and personal development

• 
A competitive compensation package including pension, insurance, laptop and mobile phone

• 
A hybrid working model offering flexibility

• 
Global career development opportunities

• 
A dynamic, inclusive and informal working environment

• 
A workplace where employee well-being and collaboration matter

Joining Global Wind Service means becoming part of a global organization where you can develop your HR expertise while contributing to an industry focused on a more sustainable future.

Global Wind Service was established in Denmark in 2008 with a clear ambition to be a preferred project partner for the installation, service and maintenance of wind turbines worldwide.

Today, Global Wind Service employs approximately 2,000 dedicated professionals and operates internationally with offices across Europe, the United States and Asia.

Global Wind Service is a Fred. Olsen related company with a long-term strategy and ownership.

At Global Wind Service, our values are:

Be Safe. Act Flexible. Take Responsibility. Focus on People.

These values guide the way we work together, make decisions and support our employees. We therefore hope you can see yourself reflected in them and bring them into your everyday approach to HR.

Role Description

We are looking for a Director (or Partner) with a track record of helping leading organisations turn strategy into execution to join our team. We are seeking a commercially driven, delivery-focused leader who can confidently bridge business and technology and bring industry and consulting perpsectives to create real impact for our customers. In this role, you will act as a commercial, professional and cultural leader within our Strategy & Transformation service offering, working closely with the leadership team to strengthen our market position. You'll take ownership of engagements from first conversation to final delivery, shaping the approach, guiding the customer and mobilising the right people to get things done. To be succesful in this role, you will need to be a sharp and credible communicator - both in writing and in person. You will need to be structured and take a high level of ownership. You will combine and balance deep advisory work with driving forward our Strategy & Transformation service offering, helping to define how we work, what we offer, and where we are headed.

What you'll be doing:

• Lead and deliver strategic transformation initiatives across business and IT, from framing the challenge with the customer to mobilising teams and driving execution.

• Advise executives on IT strategy, digitalisation and operating model design.

• Drive strategic prioritisation and enterprise-wide capacity planning, helping customers make hard choices about where to focus and how to sequence change.

• Lead organisational design initiatives, including carve-outs and post-merger integration.

• Build and expand customer relationships through trusted advisory and commercial ownership.

• Turn customer needs into proposals, pitches and new engagements, and develop and grow long-term accounts.

• Contribute to Unify Partner's growth as a company through thought leadership, market positioning and helping shape our Strategy & Transformation service offering.

Qualifications, we hope you will bring

• A minimum of 8+ years working within Strategy & Transformation - either within an external management consulting house or with a mix of industry and consulting experience

• Please note that experience working as an external consultant is a requirement for this role.

• A relevant Master's degree.

• The ability to work in both Danish and English (it's our internal language).

• Deep expertise in strategic transformation planning and execution, portfolio management, prioritisation and operating model design.

• A track record of delivery complex transformation initiatives across a range of different industries, transferring patterns and insights across contexts to create measurable impact.

On top of the hard requirements above, we are seeking a candidate with:

• proven experience in leading teams and developing others

• strong relational skills and able to build cohesion while investing in colleagues' growth

• a trusted-advisor mindset, comfortable influencing executive and board-level stakeholders

• the ability to create clarity and momentum in ambiguous situations, keeping teams focused and customers confident when the path forward isn't fully defined.

• a strong commercial instinct with a proven business development experience

• a strong track record of building and sustaining long-term customer relationships

• experience owning commercial outcomes, including scoping, pricing and negotiating engagements with a genuine appetite for building and growing our customer portfolio.

What we offer

A growing company where your voice carries real weight over how we work and evolve. We believe rest is productive, and our policies are built on trust, autonomy and flexibility. We support your growth through project leadership, client impact and thought leadership, with a clear path forward at every level.

You'll join a close-knit team that moves fast and backs each other, from Friday breakfasts to champagne rituals for new joiners and strategy tours abroad.

We offer a fair, transparent and regularly benchmarked salary, plus private health insurance, flexible pension contribution, and optional perks like discounted gym memberships and monthly office massages. You'll be based in our Copenhagen office in Sydhavn, right by the water – a bright, modern space inside a charming heritage-listed building.

About us

Unify Partners is a modern management consultancy founded in 2022 by experienced partners with a shared vision: to unify business and technology in ways that truly move the needle. In just a short time, we’ve built a strong foundation for growth, now counting 36 passionate colleagues and we’re just getting started.

We believe that the best results come from bringing diverse minds together. That’s why our culture is built around collaboration and inclusion. We call it “the power of together” - combining expertise across disciplines and working closely with our customers and partners to deliver meaningful impact.

Our values are simple but powerful: we strike a balance between delivering high-impact client work and prioritising wellbeing. We grow through knowledge sharing, mentoring and hands-on experience and we all contribute towards building a workplace where belonging and social connections thrive. If you would like to see more about our culture, check out our instagram and LinkedIn @UnifyPartners

If you’re ready to join an ambitious, fast-paced and forward-thinking team – apply today, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.occupation: Implementation Consultant with expertise in social services – Columna Cura
jobs.description:
Implementation Consultant with expertise in social services – Columna Cura

Do you know municipal case management in social services inside out – VUM, FFB, service catalogues, rates and citizens' co-payments – and would you like to help municipalities get the most out of their IT support for social services? Then seize this unique opportunity to put your professional insight to use in a company with high ambitions, and help our customers get the greatest value from Columna Cura!

Join a collaborative and ambitious team

As our new Implementation Consultant, you'll work with Columna Cura, our IT solution for the health and social care sector, which supports staff, citizens and relatives throughout the citizen's entire care journey. The solution is already live in 38 Danish municipalities, and we're growing in social services, where case management, service provision and collaboration between authority and provider place specific demands on how the system is configured and used.

You'll join the Cura Projects & Services team, made up of dedicated colleagues – consultants, solution architects, service developers and more.

The team's main responsibility is project and service delivery, and your tasks will include implementation projects, training and professional guidance on configuration.

Play a key role and contribute to Systematic's growth

As our new Implementation Consultant on Columna Cura, you'll play a key role in helping municipalities get off to a strong start with Cura in social services – and continue to get optimal value from the Cura product suite afterwards. You'll bridge the gap between the municipality's case management practices, providers' needs and the system's setup, translating assessments, service catalogues, rates and workflows between authority and provider into a well-functioning Cura setup.

Your insights from customer dialogue also feed into our product and service development.

Your key tasks will include:

• advising municipalities on how to configure Cura to support case management in social services, including VUM (the Adult Needs Assessment Method) and the process from assessment and decision to service delivery

• setting up and maintaining service catalogues (FFB – Denmark's Common Professional Concepts framework – and municipal services), rates and rules for citizens' co-payments in collaboration with the customer

• supporting collaboration between case workers and internal and external providers in Cura, including ordering, follow-up and billing of services

• training system administrators and super users to use and configure Cura

• producing and maintaining functional documentation that helps customers configure Cura to their needs

• taking part in tender responses for new customers

• working closely with your colleagues in Cura Projects & Services, Product Management and Domain Advisors, and feeding valuable customer insights from social services into our product development

You should expect around five travel days a month to customers in Denmark and Norway.

Put your social services expertise to use

Our new colleague knows social services inside out – either as a social worker with hands-on experience in case management or with providers, or as a system administrator or super user of Columna Cura or a similar IT solution for social services. You're a strong communicator who's motivated by helping others and committed to laying the groundwork for customer success and satisfaction.

We expect you to have in-depth knowledge of municipal case management in social services – particularly the VUM method, FFB and service catalogues, services, rates, citizens' co-payments, and collaboration with internal and external providers. Experience with Columna Cura or a similar specialist system for social services is a strong advantage, but the right professional insight matters more to us than the exact system you know.

It would be a huge plus if you also know the provider side of social services – for example residential care, supported housing, and activity and employment services – and understand how orders, goals, documentation and follow-up move between authority and provider. That understanding is exactly what enables you to help a municipality set up Cura so that case workers and providers work as one connected process.

We also imagine that you:

• can translate legislation and case management practice into concrete system setup and clear guidance for users

• enjoy coordinating and collaborating with customers and stakeholders – from case workers and providers to system owners and management

are proactive and take the initiative

• speak and write Danish and English fluently - Non Danish Speakers need not apply

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO/EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 social/professional events a year. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, games tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is truly international, proudly Danish and uniquely people-centric. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most – this is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. Systematic is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

You can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers almost 100 events of both social and professional character a year, so there is plenty to choose from. Our colleagues also highlight our canteen, which serves a variety of delicious and healthy dishes each day. In addition, we offer several employee benefits such as paid Home Internet, health insurance and a company pension scheme. Finally, we are always up for a friendly game of padel at our new padel court in Aarhus!

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Mette Skylvad, Program Manager.

Are you ready to power the wind industry? Do you want to work in a field where your impact matters?

Then you might be our new High Voltage Technician who is ready to start a new and adventurous journey with us!

The Role

At Global Wind Service, we are currently ramping up our expanding High Voltage Services and we are looking for you!

As a travelling High Voltage Technician, you will work globally in onshore, pre-assembly or the offshore environment. Delivering high quality solutions, with safety as the first priority to our projects.

Become a part of our High Voltage Team

In this position, you will be part of the team of our skilled technicians delivering best in class High Voltage solutions. You will be part of a growing business that continuously develops. This also means that your development is key to Global Wind Service.

Responsibilities

• 
To perform electrical tests such as VLF, MoM, Insulation and Relay Tests.

• 
To be a Team Lead for High Voltage activities.

• 
To connect High Voltage Terminations.

• 
To work according to the safety regulations.

• 
To safely operate High Voltage equipment.

Your profile

Ideally, you:

• 
Have experience with High Voltage works.

• 
Have completed a relevant electrical education.

• 
You have at least 6 months of experience in wind.

• 
Have good English skills

• 
Have ability and willingness to travel and work domestically and internationally as required

• 
Have ability and confidence to work at height (includes physical fitness to climb)

• 
Have valid GWO training and OGUK Medical Fitness certificate

• 
Are EU citizen and have EU passport

• 
Are cooperative, communicative, open-minded, and flexible – with respect for others and other cultures

• 
Can work at remote sites in adverse weather conditions

• 
Are professional with a high emphasis on Quality and Safety

• 
Possess clean drivers’ license and ability to obtain a passport

Following certificates would be beneficial

• 
Siemens Energy 8VM1

• 
EHS-8270

• 
72,5kV Cable Training

• 
Mitsubishi 72,5 SWG Training

• 
Accreditation with SGRE or Vestas

We offer you

• 
An exciting job with excellent opportunities for professional and personal development in an inspiring, dynamic, high performing and international work environment in the renewable energy sector.

• 
An opportunity to work with a leading supplier in wind industry.

• 
An opportunity to further develop your skills and professional development.

• 
Competitive remuneration.

• 
Your happiness and your well-being is a priority.

• 
A great journey with career development within a global organization.

Working at Global Wind Service

Global Wind Service is a leading international provider of turbine installation, service, and maintenance solutions in the wind industry. With a strong focus on safety, quality, and efficiency, we work closely with our clients to deliver exceptional wind energy projects worldwide. As we continue to expand our global presence, we are seeking a self-driven and experienced High Voltage Technician to join our dynamic team.

Focus on People

At GWS our employees play an integral role in our vision for the future and in achieving our goal to be the preferred partner for complete wind turbine services. GWS has a strong team culture, and we are always looking for smart, hard-working people who strive for excellence in their work and appreciate collaboration.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Imagine working with cutting-edge machine learning models, crunching high frequency data sets and sparring with exceptional and fun colleagues, all while taking part in scaling our business even further.

Does this sound highly appealing to you? Then you might be our new Senior Quantitative Researcher in the Equity Statistical Arbitrage wing of Alipes Capital!

At Alipes Capital, we have been a market leader in equity and electricity algorithmic trading since starting in 2008.

This position is focused on

• 
Elevating our predictive modeling standards to the highest levels in the area of statistical arbitrage of traded funds.

• 
Creating a world class modeling workflow, enabling the team to turn massive data sets of financial information into mathematical models that accurately predict movements in the markets.

In doing so, you will get a chance to tackle a variety of software infrastructure challenges, such as:

• 
Development and optimization of calibration and benchmarking frameworks.

• 
Building out and implementing best practices for data preparation and dataset generation pipelines.

• 
Prototyping and releasing novel predictive architectures, especially with respect to time-series models.

You will get instant validation of your work and experience short feedback cycles, where going from inception to deployment can be a matter of hours. There will be no red tape to cut and no salespeople to consult. It is pure play.

About the team

We maintain an informal atmosphere where technical discussions are valued, and you are encouraged to take ownership of, and pride in, your work. You will impact the direction of the team, prioritize your work and choose the tools that get the job done.

The Quant team consists of eighteen passionate quantitative researchers covering 6 nationalities, with thirteen PhD’s and five MSc’s with expertise in statistical analysis, mathematical modeling and machine learning. The stat-arb sub-team is a tight group of 3 researchers.

We enjoy collaboration and are always willing to lend a helping hand. We work alongside a team of software engineers and a team of traders that implement and conceive the mathematical models together with us. All team members across the organization write code and drive change and are equally willing to engage on a nitty-gritty technical level as well as discuss the larger strategic level.

About you

• 
Fluency within mathematics and statistics.

• 
Experience working with the full Machine Learning stack from data generation through model calibration and real-life validation and monitoring.

• 
Programming experience with Python, in particular data-wrangling and numerical programming.

• 
Proficiency in computer science fundamentals.

• 
A scientific and inquisitive mind.

Nice to have

• 
Experience working with financial data, in particular valuation and hedging of fixed-income instruments.

• 
Experience with order book data.

• 
Experience working with tools like PyTorch, Tensorflow, XGBoost and/or Catboost.

• 
Programming experience with languages like C# and C/C++.

• 
PhD or MSc degree in engineering, physics, computer science, mathematics or economics.

What we can offer you

• 
Competitive benefits, including pension, health insurance, and 30 days of vacation.

• 
A modern office in Copenhagen (Nordhavn) with a flexible hybrid work model.

• 
A flat hierarchy with high levels of trust, autonomy, and freedom to make decisions.

• 
A valued role with unique responsibilities and plenty of room for creativity.

• 
Fast feedback and recognition of your contributions in a high-growth company.

• 
Strong team spirit - successes are celebrated with company events and trips.

Practicalities

To apply, please send us your CV and a cover letter telling us why you think this role is a great fit for you. If your profile looks like a good match, we will get in touch to coordinate an online technical test as a first step in the interview process.

3Shape are creating a new role in R&D for an experienced Wi-Fi specialist to help ensure reliable, high-performance wireless connectivity for our scanner systems. You will work in R&D and work closely with colleagues across R&D, Customer Care, IT, Production, and Wi-Fi hardware vendors. In doing so, you will turn user and Wi-Fi requirements into stable, validated setups that work in real customer environments.

This new role focuses on Wi-Fi performance, stability, troubleshooting, verification, validation in both internal development test environments and at customers.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will be part of defining the optimal Wi-Fi and connectivity setup for 3Shape systems. By doing so, you will get to experiment and prove through verification and validation, the robustness of the selected setup(s) and its configuration. In essence, you will be driving more reliable scanner connectivity and reducing customer support issues by making initial scanner setup easy and Wi‑Fi configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting simpler, faster, and more effective for all users.

Specifically, you will get to:

• 
Debug Wi‑Fi performance, stability, and connectivity issues across Windows and Linux environments.

• 
Define, validate, and maintain robust Wi‑Fi configurations, including embedded modules, adapters, drivers, access points, and scanner connectivity setups.

• 
Develop and maintain a Wi‑Fi test lab and validation framework used to ensure reliable scanner connectivity.

• 
Improve tools, methods, and processes for diagnosing and troubleshooting Wi‑Fi issues.

• 
Act as 3Shape’s Wi‑Fi specialist across R&D, Production, Customer Care, and customers by providing technical guidance, troubleshooting support, documentation, and training.

What We Are Looking For

As this is a new role, we are open for a variety of different academic background and/or experience. Most importantly is that you have a problem-solving mindset, a proactiveness and a creativity in finding the flaws.

Likewise, we imagine that you might be able to check most of the following:

• 
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Engineering, IT or similar.

• 
Good knowledge of Wi-Fi technical standards, performance parameters, stability considerations, and practical implementation details.

• 
Basic understanding of Wi-Fi regulatory standards.

• 
Hands-on expertise with enterprise and consumer-grade Wi-Fi setups, including access points, network management, and security.

• 
Strong ability to debug Wi-Fi setups in Windows and preferably also Linux environments.

• 
Experience with Wi-Fi modules, antennas, adapters, drivers, and access points.

• 
Basic programming skills sufficient to work with module drivers, diagnostics, and scanner-related code to improve Wi-Fi performance and reliability.

• 
Understanding of network infrastructure, wireless security, and practical troubleshooting tools.

• 
Strong communication skills and the ability to work across technical teams, support functions, production, and external vendors.

• 
Pragmatic mindset with focus on stable solutions, measurable improvements, and real-world usability.

Join us in shaping a company culture that makes Monday mornings worth it.

Be part of a team working with wireless connectivity for advanced scanner products where reliability, usability, and performance are critical. You will help shape how Wi-Fi is validated, supported, and improved across development, production, and customer environments.

We are a vibrant, visionary, and international place to work. But most of all, we are a diverse group of over 50 different nationalities who all contribute to a thriving company culture. We partake in social clubs, monthly social activities, and various in-team activities as well. If that’s not enough, then add on:

• 
Central Copenhagen location

• 
3Shape is a globally recognized tech company.

• 
An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

• 
Breakfast every day, and a delicious and healthy lunch cooked by our private chefs.

• 
A joint purpose: to enable dentists to provide superior dental care to every patient, every time.

Apply Now

Job Description

We’re looking for a senior full-stack engineer with a strong interest in building AI-first products who enjoys owning problems end-to-end – from vague client needs and early hypotheses to production-grade systems that actually get used.

What you’ll do

You’ll join The Tech Collective (our Data & AI hub, specifically), where we help organisations design, build, and operationalise data- and AI-driven solutions.

This role is tailor-made for a systems thinker and builder – someone who has shipped real products, taken responsibility for technical direction, and is motivated by creating pragmatic solutions that combine data, software, and AI.

You’ll work closely with experienced AI specialists who bring deep model and ML expertise, while you focus on building robust products and software around those capabilities.

Your responsibilities will include:

• End-to-end solution ownership: designing and implementing full-stack applications from early concepts and prototypes to scalable, production-grade systems, including architecture decisions across frontend, backend, data, and cloud

• Modern full-stack development: building high-quality frontend and backend services, applying sound software engineering principles, and using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and critically

• AI-enabled product building: collaborating with AI specialists to integrate LLMs, retrieval pipelines, and agentic patterns into real products, and translating AI potential into solutions that make sense for organisations

• Data and systems thinking: designing data models, reasoning about distributed systems and trade-offs, and implementing event-driven or real-time features where they add value

• Observability and evaluation: experience setting up the right observability and eval tooling to establish traceability and iteratively improve on products

• Cloud, delivery, and collaboration: deploying and operating solutions in cloud environments, balancing speed, robustness, and security, and working closely with clients and stakeholders to create tangible business impact

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for someone with an AI builder mentality and 5+ years of hands-on full-stack experience, who is comfortable owning applications end to end – from frontend and backend to data and deployment.

You don’t need to tick every box, but you should recognise yourself in most of the following:

• Strong full-stack foundation: solid skills in TypeScript and/or Python, with experience building and shipping production systems

• Mentoring experience: helping other developers through technical sparring and code reviews

• Outward curiosity: actively seeking to understand client problems in detail and working in close collaboration with them to solve them

• Ownership and leadership: a track record of building substantial solutions from scratch (e.g., startup, scale-up, or personal ventures), taking responsibility for outcomes, and leading technical direction without relying on formal authority

• System-level thinking: the ability to reason about architecture, data flows, trade-offs, and failure modes across the stack, and to make pragmatic decisions in ambiguous contexts

• Critical technical judgement: a keen eye for identifying weaknesses in existing architectures and tech stacks, and knowing where and how to improve them

• Communication and collaboration: the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders, work across disciplines, and learn from – and share knowledge with – others in the team and across Implement

• Tool agnostic: capable of choosing the right tool for the job

What we offer

We offer a role with technical ownership and influence, working in a 20-person team that feels much closer to a nerdy startup than a large corporation – while being firmly backed by Implement Consulting Group.

You’ll gain exposure to a wide range of data- and AI-driven problems across industries, all within a culture built on trust, curiosity, humility, resilience, and impact. You’ll also have great freedom to shape your own role, deepen your expertise, and grow in exactly the direction that motivates you.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? Apply ASAP.

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We aim to make a positive difference in the consulting industry, believing that the ability to create change with impact and purpose is a prerequisite for success in a global and turbulent world.

We’re expanding our team and look forward to meeting talented people who are curious about a career in information systems and management consulting at the intersection of business and technology.

We're looking for an experienced Microsoft Purview specialist with a proven track record of delivering compliance projects for clients who’s ready to own and develop our Purview capability as the agentic landscape evolves.

What you'll do

You'll work on Microsoft Purview and compliance implementations end-to-end – from architecture and deployment to use case optimisation – with a particular focus on agentic adoption.

You'll be the person who drives the Purview agenda on behalf of an ambitious team, working across industries with organisations that are serious about data security and compliance.

In this role, you'll own:

• 
Design, deployment, and optimisation of Microsoft Purview solutions, including Data Classification, Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, and Insider Risk Management

• 
Development of data protection policies, automation workflows, and compliance reporting tailored to client requirements

• 
Assessment and reporting on the maturity of client data security and compliance deployments

• 
Definition and creation of operational and executive compliance dashboards and reports

• 
Integration activities across Microsoft Purview and the broader Microsoft 365 compliance ecosystem

You'll also collaborate closely with other engineers on the team, contribute to R&D activities, and support managed service customers in maintaining and maturing their data security practices.

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone with at least three years of hands-on experience enabling security and compliance technologies in a Microsoft environment. Beyond that, you'll bring:

• 
Strong experience with Microsoft Purview across Data Classification, Information Protection, DLP, and Insider Risk Management

• 
Hands-on experience implementing sensitivity labels, retention policies, and DLP rules

• 
Knowledge of data governance principles within the Microsoft ecosystem

• 
Current Microsoft certifications in compliance and security – or a willingness to obtain them within 90 days

Strong communication skills and confidence in client-facing settings

Knowledge of LLMs and agentic workflows, including cybersecurity risk considerations

Understanding of Zero Trust principles as applied to data security

Experience with risk assessment methodologies and compliance reporting

What we offer

Company Description

Are you the one who brings structure when things get complex, and who walks over to ask why something has stalled rather than waiting for an email? Then you might be the Student Assistant we are looking for!

At JYSK, our Operational Centre of Excellence helps teams across IT and the business units it supports work in more stable and measurable ways. We are looking for a Student Assistant for 15 hours a week to work with data and stakeholder coordination at JYSK Head Office in Aarhus.

You start as soon as we have found the right candidate. For the first six weeks you work about one day a week, then 15 hours a week over two days, with at least one of them at the office. We start with a three-month contract and hope you stay at least 12 months. We are flexible around exams and holidays.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You work directly with the Manager of IT Operational Excellence and get real responsibility from day one. Within your first three months, you will have delivered your first piece of reporting that the IT leadership team uses.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• Insight into how IT operations and continuous improvement work in an international retailer with more than 3,700 stores in 49 countries, more than 35,000 colleagues and an IT organisation of more than 400 people

• Room to shape your own role - this is a new area we are designing, and what you lean into will help define it

• A dedicated mentor, regular sparring and a network across IT that few students get

• Hands-on experience with ITIL, Lean, structured change management and the agile framework SAFe, which is how our teams work

• The option to use real cases for projects or your thesis

• Flexible hours that fit your studies and exams

• Engaged colleagues, a lunch programme with healthy and varied meals, and Friday bars

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

You help us turn improvements into results, and most of that happens in conversation with people. Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Data and insight: Collect and analyse data, build dashboards, and explain what the numbers show and how our initiatives are working.

• Following up on improvement actions: Keep track of our actions, check with the owners that they are delivered, and find out why when something stalls.

• Making larger initiatives easy to join: One example is our CMDB, a map of how applications and servers connect. You create templates, plan the steps with the teams and help remove what blocks them.

• Working with people: Talk to colleagues instead of hiding behind the screen. Join a stand-up, send a Slack message or walk over, and make it easy for people to help.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

You do not need experience. We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Is curious about data and what it tells you, with Excel as a good starting point

• Enjoys bringing structure to messy tasks

• Likes talking to people and following up until things get done

• Is motivated to learn, not least how IT runs a large retail business

• Is enrolled in a relevant higher education programme with at least 12 months of studies left

• Communicates fluently in English. Danish is a plus

• Can be at the office in Aarhus at least one day a week
